signal: [STRUCTURAL FINDING — a documented ZERO, with one correction] Across this run no open or awarded Cyprus public-procurement notice was found for: ATMs or ATM software, ATM recyclers, self-service or branch kiosks, POS terminals or terminal management, softPOS, instant payments / ISO 20022 / RTGS, transaction-monitoring or fraud systems, HSMs or payment key management, or physical ATM security (anti-skimming / IBNS). CORRECTION: payments infrastructure is NOT a total zero — the Central Bank of Cyprus awarded Tender 06/2024, 'Administration, maintenance and support of the SWIFT system and its related infrastructure', to ALLIED ENGINEERING GROUP (CYPRUS) LTD for EUR 415,000 (TED contract-award notice 667724-2025, published 10/10/2025, restricted procedure, 1 tender, CPV 72261000, contract issue 29/09/2025). The rest of the finding is structural and stands: Cyprus's five commercial banks — Bank of Cyprus, Hellenic Bank, Alpha Bank Cyprus, Eurobank Cyprus and AstroBank — are PRIVATE companies and are not contracting authorities, so their ATM/POS/self-service buying never reaches eprocurement.gov.cy or TED. The only Cyprus BANK that is a contracting authority is the state-owned Οργανισμός Χρηματοδοτήσεως Στέγης (Housing Finance Corporation). The Central Bank of Cyprus procures OUTSIDE eprocurement.gov.cy entirely, under its own 'Directives on the Regulation of Contract Award Procedures 2021 to 2025' (a regulatory administrative act harmonised with Directive 2014/24/EU), publishing in the Official Gazette of the Republic and on centralbank.cy, and on TED only above threshold — a statement confirmed verbatim on the CBC tenders page re-fetched 27/08/2026. The nearest cash-automation demand in the public feed comes from NON-BANKS: the Electricity Authority of Cyprus (banknote counters, EUR 55,000 estimate) and the Treasury (cash-in-transit, EUR 600,000 estimate).
